name: @vssaros/dsh-mcp
description: VsSaros MCP module for DeepSeek Harness: read-only view of what <data-root>/mcp.json actually mounts (server list + skip reasons + tool count). Data root follows the shared chain (config.dataRoot -> VSSAROS_DATA_ROOT -> ~/.vssaros), aligned with the sibling modules since 0.2.2. Servers themselves are mounted by the host at start (one dsh-mcp-client row per server via --patch); this package only reads the same file with the same normalization rules.
